committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 12 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The A$600 test credit is now fully drawn down (creditRemainingExGst A$0, spendExGst A$748.21 against 107 raw paid clicks), so the pause-or-continue decision is due: with review_cta_click still at 0 bookings, the standing rule says pause unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked.

Two generate_lead events have fired since the test started versus 20 ask_cta_click and 0 review_cta_click: these are unverified enquiry candidates only, and Chris needs to check the Formspree/Cal.com emails and grade them against the qualified rule before anyone calls them demand.

Raw paid clicks have reached 107, well past both the click-25 freeze and the 75-click checkpoint, with zero review_cta_click bookings recorded: the test log needs checking, since 75+ relevant clicks with zero qualified enquiries is the trigger for a red flag.

Organic Search is the one unpaid signal worth trusting, up to 14 sessions from 6 (google/organic 12 vs 6), but Search Console shows only the brand term 'kontrol ai' sitting at position 3 while most other queries sit past position 20 (business dashboard pos 39, simpro integration pos 94); AI Assistant sessions stayed at 0 for a second straight week.

actions.text: Credit remaining is A$0, so the decision point is due: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review, checked against the test log.
Raw paid clicks have hit 107, past the 75-click checkpoint: check the test log now to confirm whether qualified enquiries are still zero, which would trip the red flag.
Two generate_lead events have fired since the test started: check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source details and grade each one against the qualified rule in the test log.
The page has been frozen since click 25 and remains so at 107 clicks: no changes to headline, offer or calls to action unless the page is broken.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success: these need updating to current site stats.
